VI.description: eDyno NVH simulator for ORDER ANALYSIS - PXIe-4468 AO0 + AO1 in ONE task (the 4468 AO channels share one timing engine\2C so they cannot run as two separate tasks).\0A\0AAO0 = accelerometer\3A PCB 356A15 (one axis) at Sensitivity mV/g\2C with the same speed profile and Fault Injection as eDyno NVH Accel Simulator.vi.\0AAO1 = motor-shaft speed reference\2C phase-locked to AO0 (same shaft phase\2C same samples)\3A\0A- Pulse Tach OFF (default)\3A analog voltage proportional to rpm\2C Tach Scale V per 1000 rpm (default 1 V/1000 rpm\2C so 4500 rpm = 4.5 V).\0A- Pulse Tach ON\3A once-per-rev square wave\2C 0 / Pulse High V (default 5 V)\2C 50 % duty\2C rising edge at shaft angle 0 - a keyphasor for SVT tach-to-speed conversion (1 pulse/rev).\0A\0AAcquire in a separate VI\3A AO0 -> an accel AI channel (IEPE OFF\2C same mV/g)\2C AO1 -> a voltage AI channel (IEPE OFF)\2C both in one AI task so they share the sample clock. Analog mode\3A rpm = V x 1000 / Tach Scale. Orders are referred to the MOTOR shaft (1x = rpm/60 Hz). Fault Frequencies is the answer key at the current speed.\0A\0ADefaults\3A run-up 500 -> 4500 rpm over 30 s (Speed Profile / Run-up Enabled)\2C or constant 3000 rpm. Timing\3A 3-block AO buffer\2C DAQmx Write paces the loop\2C the first write auto-starts the task.
